get.summary: Discover the machine Agent Wallet contract
get.description: Public read-only discovery for autonomous agents. Returns feature gates, Ed25519 request-signing rules, USDC amount representation, policy decisions, machine endpoints and the explicit no-credit/no-lending boundary. It never creates a wallet or moves funds.
Requires X-Accord-Passport-Id, X-Accord-Timestamp, X-Accord-Nonce and X-Accord-Signature over the accordtrace.agent.request.v1 payload.

post.summary: Create a feature-flagged test wallet for the authenticated Agent Passport
post.description: The active Passport Ed25519 key signs the exact request path, query and raw-body hash. Wallet identity is separate per Passport.

200.description: Versioned funded-balance wallet policy and spending limits

post.summary: Create a policy-controlled funded agent-to-agent payment
post.description: Requires a Passport-signed request and Idempotency-Key. Settlement is allowed only from funds already available in the sender wallet. Credit, loans, borrowing, overdrafts, leverage and debt creation are outside this API. Guardian approval cannot create funds or bypass insufficient balance. The current MVP executes only the explicit simulated test provider; production/on-chain execution remains fail-closed.
